name: Marine Bioprospecting
description: Overview of marine bioresources, application of marine resources in human healthcare, marine biomedical research and development; drug discovery continuum in marine biotechnology, omics, marine derived biosensors, biomaterials, bionanotechnology, bioactive compounds, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, cosmeceuticals, novel technologies in marine research, marine biomimetics for sustainable development, case studies, emerging issues and challenges; IPRs, marine biodiversity and traditional knowledge (medicine).
